name: Dawn of the Universe
source:
One day, the Universe burst into existence. Join our host as they aim to take you on a journey through the Universe!!! (...I think?)

[From [url=https://megapig9001.itch.io/dawn-of-the-universe]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
某一天，宇宙轰然诞生。快跟上我们的主持人，随他们一同踏上穿越宇宙的奇妙旅程吧！！！（……大概吧？）
